name: AIDE Signal
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one brand-new square transparent PNG avatar for AIDE, the helpful assistant in Imperial Ops, a calm grey operations dashboard.

Primary request: invent ONE fresh Star Wars-universe service droid character WEARING clearly recognisable over-ear headphones. This is a new character, not a variation sheet and not an edit of another image.
Subject: AIDE Signal, a small attentive starship communications companion. An original squat softly trapezoidal pale pewter droid head, rounded corners and a slightly domed crown, a recessed broad charcoal faceplate with TWO large glossy black optical lenses with quiet silver-grey reflections. The lenses are slightly asymmetric and the whole head has a subtle listening tilt, giving gentle dry-witted personality. A small simple mechanical collar below the head, no full body. Restrained practical Star Wars prop language: precision panel breaks, a couple of inset screws, very faint wear on the edges.
HEADPHONES: unmistakably a separate wearable set of retro-futurist OVER-EAR HEADPHONES. Broad curved matte graphite headband visibly arches over the crown with a little clear space between band and head, large circular brushed-silver earcups on BOTH sides, thick soft charcoal padded cushions between earcups and the droid head, understated metal yokes. The headphones should read instantly even at 36px. Headphones naturally sized for the droid, not enormous. No cables or mic boom crossing the face.
Style/medium: premium stylised 3D character render, beautifully crafted industrial object, big simple readable shapes, friendly and capable rather than babyish, physical matte metal, subtle worn enamel and rubber.
Composition: exactly one character, centred front three-quarter portrait with both earcups clearly visible; head and short neck fill about 78% of a square frame. Entire headphone headband and both earcups fully inside frame with generous transparent safety margin. No cropping of head or headphones.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio lighting, restrained rim separation for readability against dark and light dashboard surfaces. Calm, attentive, quietly companionable.
Colour palette: STRICTLY ACHROMATIC GREYSCALE. Light grey enamel, graphite, brushed neutral silver, charcoal rubber, black glass eyes, soft silver highlights. Zero chromatic saturation, no cream or beige tint, no coloured lights, no LED glow.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no background scene, no floor, no cast shadow behind the character, no checkerboard drawn in the image.
Constraints: one single head portrait; no text, labels, logos, watermark, badge, circular background, weapons, human features, humanoid ears, dangling arms, or tiny clutter. Distinct from R2-D2, BB-8, BD-1 and K-2SO while belonging convincingly in the same lived-in science-fiction world. Headphones are the defining accessory.
